title: Haida Gold Ocean Adventures
specs: Captain Mike Bellis is a Haida Nation member and Transport Canada certified vessel operator
Boat is a 30ft Mainship Pilot RumRunner II with covered cabin and enclosed bathroom
Opportunities to see bald eagles, harbour seals, whales, dolphins, and coastal scenery
Fishing licence required for all who fish, including children; free for under 16 but must be recorded
Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult and wear life jackets
Inform Captain of any medical conditions prior to departure
Recommended to take motion sickness remedy before trip if prone
Maximum 7 passengers on scenic cruises; 5 for fishing (more possible with children under 10)
Jedediah Island adventure and Fireworks Cruise limited to 6 passengers
All charters are private; no individual seats sold

blurb: Guests explore coastal waters of Vancouver Island and the Salish Sea aboard a 30ft Mainship Pilot RumRunner II. Activities include sportfishing with premium gear, scenic cruises, and special event charters like fireworks and memorial cruises. The boat features a covered cabin, enclosed bathroom, galley for picnics, and safety equipment.
extraNote: 50% deposit required at booking; full payment due 72 hours before departure · Cancellation refund if notified in writing 30+ days before, less $50 fee · Deposits non-refundable if cancelled less than 30 days before; no refund if no-show or after final payment · Captain may cancel or end trip early for safety or intoxicated behavior; no refund in such cases · Charters proceed in rain/wind unless unsafe; no refund if customer cancels due to weather · Courtyard area in front of the marina office, Fairwinds Marina at Schooner Cove, 3521 Dolphin Drive, Nanoose Bay, BC
